claims.text: Defer ART 4 to 6 wks after starting antifungals for CNS cryptococcosis.
claims.quote: ART initiation generally is deferred for 4 to 6 weeks after antifungal agents are started for treatment of CNS cryptococcosis (AI)
claims.locator: Guidelines for the Prevention and Treatment of Opportunistic Infections in Adults and Adolescents With HIV: Cryptococcosis

claims.text: COAT: earlier ART → ↑26-wk mortality vs deferred.
claims.quote: The 26-week mortality with earlier ART initiation was significantly higher than with deferred ART initiation
claims.locator: Boulware DR, et al. Timing of antiretroviral therapy after diagnosis of cryptococcal meningitis (COAT). N Engl J Med 2014;370(26):2487-2498

claims.text: ⍉routine corticosteroids during induction unless for IRIS.
claims.quote: Corticosteroids should not be used routinely during induction therapy unless used for management of IRIS (AI)
claims.locator: Guidelines for the Prevention and Treatment of Opportunistic Infections in Adults and Adolescents With HIV: Cryptococcosis
